articles.title: Burnham scraps controversial plans to curb jury trials
articles.description: The key policy idea announced by David Lammy when he was justice secretary will no longer go ahead.

articles.title: Australia investigating Flydubai co-pilot's links to country
articles.description: State police and the country's security agency are looking into the co-pilot, who attempted to take control of a Flydubai plane travelling to Israel.

articles.title: Kyiv bridge hit in further Russian drone attack as German chancellor makes surprise visit
articles.description: Unverified video shows a drone hitting the Northern Bridge as vehicles move across it, creating a large fireball.

articles.title: Cornell president says university 'must do better' after frat house rape allegations
articles.description: Michael Kotlikoff described the allegations of a woman who says she was drugged and gang raped as "deeply disturbing".
